subject.title: feat: add location-scoped history and location registry

question: How should existing v1 balance location IDs acquire the required human-readable registry names during the v2 migration?
rationale: The old schema stores location IDs but no registry display name, so choosing placeholder names, operator-supplied mapping, or a staged migration changes the durable product contract.

options.title: Add a staged mapping migration
options.body: Require an explicit operator-supplied mapping for populated v1 pools so permanent IDs and meaningful names are preserved before enabling registry lifecycle operations.

options.title: Use deterministic placeholder names
options.body: Backfill active registry rows using the legacy location IDs as provisional names and document the rename path after upgrade.

options.title: Defer the v2 storage upgrade
options.body: Keep the registry contract off the Cloudflare migration path until an approved legacy-location migration design exists.

recommendation.title: Add a staged mapping migration
recommendation.body: Require an explicit operator-supplied mapping for populated v1 pools so permanent IDs and meaningful names are preserved before enabling registry lifecycle operations.

likelyOwner.reason: The submitted architecture records Bobby as the decision source for the location lifecycle contract.
